children: 21Shares Hyperliquid Staking ETF reported a $22.1M increase in net assets from operations, driven primarily by HYPE’s 35.56% price rise and $18.1M in unrealized appreciation. The Trust had no operations in the prior-year period, so year-over-year comparisons are unavailable.
: The Trust’s Principal Market NAV rose 27.55%, primarily as HYPE increased 35.56%, from $65.43 to $88.70.
: An average of 91.04% of HYPE holdings was staked during the quarter; 85.92% was staked at September 30.
: 280,000 Shares were created and 390,000 redeemed, a net decrease of 110,000 Shares.
: The Trust declared a $338,707 staking-income distribution, or $0.191360 per Share, on September 29.
